@[expose] noncomputable def productFast (bound : Nat) : List (Nat × Nat × PrimeCert) → Option Nat :=
  List.rec (some 1) (fun x _ tail =>
    Option.rec none (fun f => (f.beq 0).rec
      (boundedPowMul bound x.2.2.subject f x.2.1.succ)
      (Option.rec none (fun _ => some 0) (boundedPowMul bound x.2.2.subject 1 x.2.1.succ))) tail)
@[expose] def pockFast (n : Nat) (fs : List (Nat × Nat × PrimeCert)) : Bool :=
  (2 : Nat).ble n && (n.mod 2).beq 1 && subjectsOk fs &&
    Option.rec false (fun f => ((n.sub 1).mod f).beq 0 && n.blt (f.mul f) &&
       List.rec true (fun x _ tail => (checkWitness n x.2.2.subject x.1).and' tail) fs)
      (productFast (n.sub 1) fs)
theorem whole31 : Hex.Nat.Prime 2147483647 := by exact prime_of_checkPrimeAt (c := c31) (by decide +kernel)
theorem whole61 : Hex.Nat.Prime 1945555039024054273 := by exact prime_of_checkPrimeAt (c := c61) (by decide +kernel)

theorem productFast31 : productFast 2147483646 [(3,0,PrimeCert.small 151),(3,0,PrimeCert.small 331)] = some 49981 := by decide +kernel

meta partial def inlineLocal (env : Lean.Environment) (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.Expr :=
  e.replace fun sub => match sub with
    | .const n levels =>
      if env.isImportedConst n then none else
        match env.find? n with
        | some info => (info.value? (allowOpaque := true)).map fun value =>
            inlineLocal env (value.instantiateLevelParams info.levelParams levels)
        | none => none
    | _ => none


run_cmd do
  let env ← Lean.getEnv
  let original := env
  let ready ← IO.mkRef env.toKernelEnv
  let ready ← ready.get
  let env := Lean.Environment.ofKernelEnv ready
  let names := [`whole31, `whole61, `check31, `check61, `witness61, `fermat61, `half61, `product61, `bounded61, `table151, `table331, `fermat31, `unit, `product31, `productFast31, `productFast61, `pockFast31, `pock31]
  for block in [0:4] do
    for name in (if block % 2 == 0 then names else names.reverse) do
      let some (.thmInfo info) := original.find? name | throwError "missing theorem"
      let value := inlineLocal original info.value
      let type := inlineLocal original info.type
      let proof := Lean.mkApp (Lean.mkLambda `h .default type (Lean.mkBVar 0)) value
      let input ← IO.mkRef (env, proof)
      for rep in [0:10] do
        let (env, proof) ← input.get
        let start ← IO.monoNanosNow
        let checked ← IO.mkRef (Lean.Kernel.check env {} proof)
        let checked ← checked.get
        let stop ← IO.monoNanosNow
        match checked with
        | .error _ => throwError "kernel rejected profile proof"
        | .ok _ => pure ()
        Lean.logInfo m!"PROFILE {block} {name} {rep} {stop - start}"
